name: 3I/ATLAS
note: Metadata and links only: we did not process these images. IRSA warns the comet is spatially extended at SPHEREx resolution and has low S/N at many wavelengths, and does not recommend the SPHEREx Spectrophotometry Tool for it.

spherex_observations.summary: SPHEREx observed 3I/ATLAS in August and December 2025 (pre- and post-perihelion).
spherex_observations.count_source: file list of IRSA's download script (3IATLASImages-wget.sh, dated 2026-01-14)

irsa.observation_table_note: One row per spectral image: access URL, predicted comet position for the exposure (comet_ra, comet_dec) and other metadata. Can be uploaded into the IRSA Viewer.

spherex_results.title: SPHEREx Discovery of Strong Water Ice Absorption and an Extended Carbon Dioxide Coma in 3I/ATLAS
highlights: Strong water-ice absorption in the 1.5-4.0 um continuum, similar to Kuiper Belt objects and distant comets.
Extended CO2 gas coma, at least ~348,000 km across in the first analysis (SPHEREx news release).

spherex_results.title: SPHEREx Pre-Perihelion Mapping of H2O, CO2, and CO in Interstellar Object 3I/ATLAS
spherex_results.reference: Lisse et al., ApJ Letters 2026 (arXiv:2512.07318), August 2025 data
highlights: Robust H2O gas emission at 2.7-2.8 um and CO2 at 4.23-4.27 um; tentative 13CO2 and CO.
CO2 atmosphere extending to at least ~420,000 km.
Production rates Q(H2O) ~ 3.2e26 and Q(CO2) ~ 1.6e27 molecules/s (as quoted from the abstract).
Interpretation: a CO2-rich, CO-poor, thermally processed object, closer to 1I/'Oumuamua than to 2I/Borisov.

spherex_results.title: SPHEREx Re-Observation of Interstellar Object 3I/ATLAS in December 2025: Detection of Increased Post-Perihelion Activity, Refractory Coma Dust, and New Coma Gas Species
highlights: Much more active after perihelion: refractory dust in the coma and new gas species.

ruta_del_agua: Water from outside the Solar System: SPHEREx saw water ice and water vapour, and a large carbon dioxide coma, in a comet that formed around another star.
sources_checked: 2026-11-14: IRSA 3I/ATLAS page, SPHEREx news release, ADS/arXiv abstracts. Numbers are quoted, not re-derived.
